sections.Profile:
"Andromeda," released by Game Plan Inc. in September 1985, is a solid-state pinball machine known for its challenging gameplay and striking artwork by Paul Faris. Designed by Ed Cebula and Mike Kubin, it features two flippers, four pop bumpers, a bank of six drop targets, and a single spinning target.
